findings.title: selves are governed created objects
findings.claim: The group’s own selves are presented as objects of the creation they were not granted to witness.
findings.mechanism: The construct phrase places the possessed selves under the repeated creation noun, so the group remains inside the created object rather than outside it.
findings.reader_payoff: The denial reaches the would-be witnesses’ own origin and removes their claim to stand beyond it.
findings.containment: The ordinary created-selves reading remains primary; the wider self lexicon is not asserted as separate senses.

epistemic.reason: The focus surface and trusted word-analysis support directly establish this bounded relation.
